answer: Make each identity keep one verifiable delay chain running without pause, growing link by link like coral on a reef. Every epoch it reports its newest link plus beacon-picked older links, each with a short proof, so a gap shows. A chain cannot be split across cores, and it starts from the identity's own key and the beacon, so no shared trellis of precomputed links helps. One honest agent keeps one core busy; a farm of a thousand keeps a thousand busy around the clock, and a lapse cannot be caught up. Free sybils become a fable.
